code.text: CHEM

text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows marked hypoxemia, leukopenia, thrombocytopenia, and low neutrophil and lymphocyte percentages, suggesting possible bone marrow suppression or acute infection. Elevated basophils, monocytes, and alkaline phosphatase may indicate an inflammatory or reactive process. Liver and renal function, as well as electrolytes, are within normal limits except for mild hyperchloremia. Clinical correlation and further investigation are recommended.
